items.title_en: Theoretical prediction of assembly contiguity
items.title_zh: 组装连续性的理论预测
items.abstract_en: Theoretical methods for predicting the performance of assembly algorithms have the potential to guide experimental design on a scale that simulations cannot. A fundamental question of experimental design is how deep to sequence in order to obtain an assembly with long-enough contigs. More precisely, given a certain read length and coverage, what is the expected contig length that an assembler would produce on a given genome? The foundational work of Lander and Waterman tackled this question, but their method is not applicable to modern high-throughput sequencing. In this paper, we derive what we call a Z-value, which is a formula that takes as input the read length, coverage, and basic properties of the genome, and returns a prediction of the mean contig length produced by a simple single-k assembler on error-free data. We show on a benchmark of 14 genomes that the Z-value is highly accurate, with a mean absolute prediction error of less than 2 percent. We further show how this formula can be used to determine the best choice of k for the assembler and how to choose a coverage level that gives contig lengths within a desired fraction of the optimal. Finally, we show how the Z-value can also predict the performance of a more complicated assembler like Velvet and how it can be used to guide the choice between instruments when there is a tradeoff between coverage and read length and the budget is limited.
items.abstract_zh: 预测组装算法性能的理论方法有潜力以仿真无法达到的规模指导实验设计。实验设计的一个基本问题是测序深度应多深才能获得重叠群足够长的组装。更准确地说，给定一定的读长和覆盖度，组装器在给定基因组上产生的预期重叠群长度是多少？Lander 和 Waterman 的基础工作处理了这个问题，但他们的方法不适用于现代高通量测序。在本文中，我们推导了所谓的 Z-value，这是一个公式，以读长、覆盖度和基因组的基本性质为输入，返回简单单-k 组装器在无错误数据上产生的平均重叠群长度的预测。我们在 14 个基因组的基准上表明，Z-value 具有很高准确性，平均绝对预测误差低于 2%。我们进一步展示了该公式如何用于确定组装器 k 的最佳选择，以及如何选择使重叠群长度处于最优值期望比例内的覆盖度水平。最后，我们展示了 Z-value 如何也能预测像 Velvet 这样更复杂组装器的性能，以及当覆盖度和读长之间存在权衡且预算有限时，如何用它指导仪器之间的选择。

items.title_en: PolyGPT: A Decoder-Only Transformer for Polymer Electrolyte Design
items.title_zh: PolyGPT：用于聚合物电解质设计的仅解码器Transformer
items.abstract_en: Designing polymer electrolytes requires control over both material properties and chemical structure. Here, we present PolyGPT, a Transformer with 38.3 million parameters that generates polymer repeat units from optional property targets, requests to include or exclude a specified chemical feature, and an electrolyte-domain condition. Using the model selected by validation loss, we compared unconditional generation with requests for electrolyte-associated structures, a low glass-transition temperature (Tg), or both. Unconditional and electrolyte-only generation achieved structural validity of 99.46% and 99.59%, respectively. However, electrolyte conditioning increased repetition: uniqueness among valid outputs fell from 99.99% to 51.74%. At a Tg target of 246.11 K, we compared generation with and without electrolyte conditioning, and adding the electrolyte condition slightly reduced the predictor-estimated mean absolute error from 26.97 to 26.07 K, but the fraction of all attempts yielding distinct valid polymers within 50 K of the target fell from 82.35% to 32.31%. When we also required absence from the training catalog, these yields were 59.90% and 19.71%, respectively. The lower yield persisted with a tighter 25 K tolerance. Domain conditioning also weakened control of inclusion requests: the mean fraction of attempts producing valid polymers containing the requested chemical feature fell from 94.27% to 31.27%. Across nine checkpoints, earlier models sometimes produced more distinct, catalog-unseen polymers meeting the Tg target: 10,000 checkpoint model with electrolyte conditioning and 30,000 checkpoint model without it. Together, these results show why property error alone is insufficient for evaluating conditional polymer generation. It must be considered alongside repetition, training-catalog novelty, and whether combined design requests are satisfied.
items.abstract_zh: 设计聚合物电解质需要同时控制材料性质和化学结构。在此，我们提出 PolyGPT，一个具有 3830 万参数的 Transformer，可根据可选性质目标、包含或排除指定化学特征的请求，以及电解质域条件生成聚合物重复单元。使用由验证损失选择的模型，我们比较了无条件生成与请求电解质相关结构、低玻璃化转变温度（Tg）或两者兼有的生成。无条件生成和仅电解质生成的结构有效性分别达到 99.46% 和 99.59%。然而，电解质条件化增加了重复：有效输出中的唯一性从 99.99% 降至 51.74%。在 Tg 目标为 246.11 K 时，我们比较了带与不带电解质条件化的生成，加入电解质条件使预测器估计的平均绝对误差从 26.97 K 略微降至 26.07 K，但在目标 50 K 范围内产生不同有效聚合物的所有尝试比例从 82.35% 降至 32.31%。当我们还要求不在训练目录中时，这些比例分别为 59.90% 和 19.71%。在更严格的 25 K 容差下，较低的比例持续存在。域条件化也削弱了对包含请求的控制：产生包含所请求化学特征的有效聚合物的尝试平均比例从 94.27% 降至 31.27%。在九个检查点上，较早的模型有时产生更多不同的、训练目录中未见且满足 Tg 目标的聚合物：带电解质条件化的 10,000 检查点模型和不带该条件的 30,000 检查点模型。总之，这些结果表明为什么仅靠性质误差不足以评估条件聚合物生成。必须将其与重复性、训练目录新颖性以及组合设计请求是否满足一同考虑。

items.title_en: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue
items.title_zh: MedGraph：利用图记忆在长期医疗对话中维护患者状态
items.abstract_en: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.
items.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的医疗助手若要在多次就诊中跟踪患者，就需要一种能在患者临床状态变化时保持其正确的记忆。我们考察了五种记忆系统在纵向医疗对话中的错误，并发现三个反复出现的原因：检索到的证据给出过时状态、包含他人的健康事实，或缺少答案所依赖的安全事实。我们提出 MedGraph，一种针对这三种情况构建的图记忆。构建时从每次会话中抽取带日期的事实，将每个事实归因于其所描述的人，并将药物、诊断和测量记录链接成保留较早状态的链。检索时以患者链为单位排序，在问题所询问的时间点读取每条链，并加入原始对话文本；患者档案在每次问题中列出所有记录的安全事实。在 MedMemoryBench 上，MedGraph 在 GPT 和 Qwen 主干下均具有最高总体准确率，分别比五个基线中最强者高 10.5 和 10.4 个百分点，并在 GPT 设置下具有高效的记忆构建和回答。

items.title_en: Safeguarding Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles with Recursively Feasible Control Barrier Functions
items.title_zh: 使用递归可行控制屏障函数保障网联自动驾驶车辆的多智能体强化学习安全
items.abstract_en: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) shows promise in coordinating connected and automated vehicles but offers no safety guarantee. Although Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) can add this guarantee, their optimization problem can become infeasible in practice due to control bounds. Moreover, they often overapproximate vehicle and road geometry, which makes them conservative. This paper proposes the Backup-Horizon CBF (BH-CBF), which evaluates safety along a horizon until all vehicles stop. BH-CBF is recursively feasible under control bounds, and it considers the exact vehicle and road geometry. Based on BH-CBF, we derive a fully decentralized safety filter that only needs a single broadcast of vehicle states and routes per step and stays real-time in dense traffic. We use BH-CBF to safeguard a MARL policy over its life cycle: as a reward during pre-training, as a run-time filter at deployment, and as a filter in the training loop that keeps fine-tuning on unseen maps collision-free. In simulations on real-world maps of a roundabout and an intersection, BH-CBF avoids all collisions of unsafe MARL policies and keeps its safety guarantee at every step. Existing filters either collide, lose the guarantee, or fall back to full braking far more often. In recorded roundabout traffic with 1264 human-driven vehicles over 115 km, our safeguarded policies shorten the median travel time by 14% compared with the human drivers, without any collision.
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在协调网联自动驾驶车辆方面展现出潜力，但不提供安全保障。尽管控制屏障函数（CBF）可以补充这一保障，但由于控制约束，它们的优化问题在实践中可能变得不可行。此外，它们通常对车辆和道路几何进行过度近似，从而使其保守。本文提出备份时域CBF（BH-CBF），它沿一个时域评估安全性，直到所有车辆停止。BH-CBF在控制约束下是递归可行的，并且考虑了精确的车辆和道路几何。基于BH-CBF，我们推导出一种完全分散的安全滤波器，每步仅需一次车辆状态和路径的广播，并在密集交通中保持实时性。我们使用BH-CBF在MARL策略的整个生命周期中保障其安全：在预训练阶段作为奖励，在部署时作为运行时滤波器，以及在训练循环中作为滤波器，使在未见地图上的微调保持无碰撞。在环岛和十字路口的真实地图仿真中，BH-CBF避免了不安全MARL策略的所有碰撞，并在每一步保持其安全保证。现有滤波器要么发生碰撞，要么失去保证，要么更频繁地退化为全力制动。在包含1264辆人类驾驶车辆、总里程115公里的环岛交通记录中，我们受保障的策略相比人类驾驶员将中位行驶时间缩短了14%，且没有任何碰撞。
